name: Unreadable (Sp)
body:
Prerequisite: Saboteur 16

Benefit: The saboteur is an enigma to outside divinations. She is treated as though under the effect of a mind blank spell, using her saboteur level as her caster level. She can suspend or resume this ability as a standard action; if it’s dispelled she cannot resume it for 1 minute.
